data.title: (Senior) Digital Strategist (m/w/d)

data.description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Du reportest nicht, was passiert ist. Du sorgst dafür, dass wir wissen, was als Nächstes passieren muss.

Pammys ist in nur vier Jahren auf über 1 Million Kundinnen und Kunden gewachsen und gehört zu den am schnellsten wachsenden E-Commerce-Unternehmen Europas.

Heute arbeiten über 150 Mitarbeitende an unseren Standorten in Hamburg, Kiel und unserem eigenen 22.000 m² Logistikzentrum in Lensahn daran, aus Pammys eine globale Footwear Brand zu machen.

Mit einem Umsatz im mittleren 8-stelligen Bereich, mehreren Millionen Euro Marketinginvestitionen pro Monat, internationalem Wachstum und einem Produktvolumen in Millionenhöhe wird eine Sache immer wichtiger:

Finanzielle Steuerung auf höchstem Niveau.

Deshalb bauen wir unser Controlling massiv aus und suchen vier (Senior) Controller / Finance Business Partner (m/w/d), die gemeinsam mit uns die nächste Wachstumsphase steuern.

Bei uns geht es nicht darum, Excel-Dateien zu verwalten oder rückblickend Zahlen zusammenzufassen.

Du sitzt nah an den Entscheidungen, challengest Annahmen, erkennst Abweichungen frühzeitig und übersetzt Zahlen in konkrete Maßnahmen.

Dein Ziel: Wachstum profitabel machen und jederzeit wissen, welche Stellschraube den größten finanziellen Impact hat.

Je nach Erfahrung und Schwerpunkt übernimmst du Verantwortung für einen oder mehrere unserer zentralen Unternehmensbereiche wie Marketing & E-Commerce, Product & Sourcing, Operations & Logistics oder Corporate Finance.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst als Finance Business Partner die finanzielle Steuerung eines oder mehrerer zentraler Unternehmensbereiche und arbeitest eng mit den jeweiligen Führungskräften zusammen.
  • Du steuerst relevante KPIs, Budgets und Ergebnisgrößen und stellst sicher, dass Abweichungen nicht nur erkannt, sondern aktiv adressiert werden.
  • Du analysierst unsere P&L und Deckungsbeiträge bis auf Produkt-, Kanal-, Markt- oder Kostenstellenebene und identifizierst konkrete Ergebnishebel.
  • Du erstellst Forecasts, Szenarioanalysen und Business Cases und zeigst transparent, welchen finanziellen Effekt unterschiedliche Entscheidungen haben.
  • Du begleitest unsere Budget- und Jahresplanung und entwickelst sie zu einem dynamischen Steuerungsinstrument weiter.
  • Du analysierst Kostenentwicklungen und hinterfragst bestehende Strukturen konsequent auf Effizienz, Skalierbarkeit und Profitabilität.
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Finance und Data aussagekräftige Management-Reportings, Dashboards und Frühwarnsysteme.
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Führungskräfte jederzeit die Zahlen kennen, die sie für ihre Entscheidungen tatsächlich benötigen.
  • Du verbindest operative KPIs mit finanziellen Auswirkungen und schaffst so Transparenz darüber, wo wir Geld verdienen, verlieren oder investieren sollten.
  • Du entwickelst klare Zielbilder, Benchmarks und Performance-KPIs für deine Verantwortungsbereiche und begleitest deren Umsetzung.
  • Du unterstützt bei Liquiditätsplanung, Cashflow-Steuerung und Working Capital Management.
  • Du analysierst Bestände, Einkauf, Zahlungsziele und Kapitalbindung und identifizierst Potenziale zur Verbesserung unseres Cash Conversion Cycles.
  • Du baust unsere Controlling-Prozesse weiter auf und treibst Automatisierung, Standardisierung und Digitalisierung konsequent voran.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung, Finance, Accounting, Data sowie den operativen Fachbereichen zusammen.


Dein Profil

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, Finance, Controlling, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Du bringst mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im Controlling, FP&A oder Finance Business Partnering mit.
  • Besonders spannend ist Erfahrung aus E-Commerce, D2C, Retail, Fashion, FMCG oder einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen.
  • Du verstehst eine P&L nicht nur technisch, sondern kannst erklären, welche operative Entscheidung hinter einer Veränderung steckt.
  • Begriffe wie Contribution Margin, Cashflow, Working Capital, Forecast und Business Case gehören zu deinem täglichen Werkzeug.
  • Du bist extrem sicher in Excel oder Google Sheets und kannst auch große Datenmengen strukturiert analysieren.
  • Erfahrung mit BI-Tools, ERP-Systemen und automatisierten Reportings ist ein großes Plus.
  • Du arbeitest analytisch und präzise, verlierst dich aber nicht in Analysen, sondern kommst schnell zu einer klaren Empfehlung.
  • Du hast den Anspruch, Zahlen zu challengen, statt sie lediglich entgegenzunehmen.
  • Du kannst komplexe Sachverhalte so erklären, dass auch Nicht-Finanzler unmittelbar verstehen, was zu tun ist.
  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, übernimmst Verantwortung und fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, in dem Entscheidungen schnell getroffen und Ergebnisse klar gemessen werden.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.


Deine Vorteile bei Pammys

  • Echter Einfluss: Deine Analysen landen nicht in einer Präsentation, sondern direkt in operativen und strategischen Entscheidungen.
  • Direkter Management-Zugang: Du arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung, Finance Leadership und den Verantwortlichen unserer Business Units zusammen.
  • Unternehmerisches Controlling: Du bekommst eigene Verantwortungsbereiche und wirst zum Sparringspartner für die jeweiligen Führungskräfte.
  • Außergewöhnliche Skalierung: Du begleitest ein Unternehmen auf dem Weg vom mittleren 8-stelligen in den mittleren 9-stelligen Umsatzbereich.
  • Komplexität, an der du wachsen kannst: E-Commerce, Marketing, internationale Märkte, eigene Logistik, Sourcing und Millionen von Produkten ergeben ein Finance-Umfeld, das weit über klassisches Controlling hinausgeht.
  • Gestaltung statt Verwaltung: Viele Strukturen entstehen gerade erst. Du kannst Prozesse, Dashboards, KPIs und Steuerungsmodelle aktiv mit aufbauen.
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege: Keine endlosen Abstimmungsschleifen. Gute Analysen werden schnell in Entscheidungen übersetzt.
  • High-Performance-Umfeld: Klare Ziele, messbare Ergebnisse, hohe Eigenverantwortung und der Anspruch, jeden Bereich kontinuierlich besser zu machen.
  • Entwicklungsperspektive: Mit dem weiteren Wachstum entstehen zusätzliche Verantwortungsbereiche und Führungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb unseres Finance-Teams.
  • Zusätzliche Benefits: Mitarbeiterrabatte, Corporate Benefits, kostenlose Getränke und weitere Vorteile.

data.description:
Ninox ist eine Berliner Low-Code-Plattform, mit der Teams genau die Geschäftsanwendungen bauen, die sie brauchen. Rund 80 Mitarbeitende, tausende Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa, vom kleinen Team bis zum Großunternehmen. Ein Produkt, an dem Menschen wirklich hängen. Wir sind seit 12 Jahren am Markt, etabliert, wachsen und sind solide mit Wagniskapital finanziert.

Aufgaben

Du leitest Finance, IT, People und Operations: neun Menschen in vier Disziplinen. Deine Aufgabe ist es, diese vier Disziplinen zu führen, zu entwickeln und auf gemeinsame Standards, Servicelevel und Prioritäten auszurichten. Auch dort, wo du selbst nicht die Fachexpertin oder der Fachexperte bist. Gleichzeitig bist du Ansprechpartner für das C-Level (CEO, CGO und CRO) und die Teamleads in den anderen Abteilungen.

Der Schwerpunkt deiner Ergebnisverantwortung liegt dabei eindeutig im Finanzbereich. Dort führst du ein Team von vier Personen in der Debitoren- und Kreditorenbuchhaltung (AR/AP) und verantwortest den Rechnungslegungszyklus von Anfang bis Ende: Buchhaltung, Zahlungsläufe, Mahnwesen und Payroll bis hin zum abgeschlossenen Monat und den Zahlen, die das Haus verlassen. Du überschaust die Systeme, die diese Zahlen erzeugen – DATEV, Billing-Plattformen, CRM und Data Warehouse und bist in der Lage diese nach modernen KI basierten Standards miteinander zu verzahnen um ein fortlaufendes Reporting aufzubauen.

Es ist weder eine rein strategische noch eine rein operative Position. Für IT und Office führst du über Standards, Servicelevel und Prioritäten: Hardware, Onboarding, Compliance Standards wie ISO 27001 und 9001 sind dabei von dir zu koordinieren.

Unser CFO wechselt begleitend in ein Fractional-Modell und bleibt bei Board-, Finanzierungs- und Transaktionsthemen eng dabei, du bekommst also einen erfahrenen Sparringspartner, ohne dass jemand über deinem Tagesgeschäft sitzt.

Qualifikation

  • Mehrere Jahre in einer leitenden Finanzfunktion in einem wachsenden Unternehmen, mit eigener Verantwortung für den Monatsabschluss vom Buchungssatz bis zum Reporting. In einem Team dieser Größe ist die Führungskraft Spielertrainer:in: Du kannst die Arbeit auch selbst machen, wenn jemand ausfällt.
  • Solide deutsche Rechnungslegungspraxis – HGB, DATEV, Payroll und die Zusammenarbeit mit dem Steuerberater. Praktisch, nicht theoretisch.
  • Führungserfahrung: Du hast ein Team fachlich und disziplinarisch geführt – idealerweise in der Buchhaltung – und traust dir zu, auch für IT und People Standards zu setzen, ohne Sysadmin oder Arbeitsrechtlerin zu sein.
  • Sicherheit bei SaaS-Kennzahlen: ARR, MRR, Brutto- und Nettoretention, Rechnungsabgrenzung, Kohorten-Analyse und dem entsprechenden Reporting.
  • Nachweisliche Erfahrung darin, einen manuellen Prozess durch einen echten zu ersetzen: ein Reporting, das sich selbst baut; eine Abstimmung, die keine Person mehr braucht. Du musst kein SQL schreiben, solltest aber über Data Warehouse, Billing-System und CRM sprechen können, ohne dafür einen Entwickler im Raum zu brauchen.
  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher – Arbeits- und Abschlusssprache in dieser Rolle – sowie fließendes Englisch.
  • Von Vorteil: Due Diligence, Audit oder eine Finanzierungsrunde von innen erlebt; Berührung mit Förderprogrammen wie GRW oder IBB.
  • Erfahrung mit verschiedenen Compliance Frameworks wie ISO, GRC, ISMS, etc. geben dir einen erheblichen Vorteil im Prozess.

Benefits

  • 100.000–120.000 € Grundgehalt je nach Erfahrung, dazu ein variabler Anteil, gekoppelt an eine Scorecard, die du mitgestaltest.
  • pot. Beteiligung an unserem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm (ESOP).
  • Ein echtes Mandat: vier Funktionen, neun Menschen und das Mandat Prozesse effektiv und wachstumsorientiert zu gestalten.
  • Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro am Monbijouplatz in Berlin-Mitte
  • 30 Urlaubstage, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, BVG Ticket und weitere Benefits
  • Ein Unternehmen, klein genug, dass deine Entscheidungen sichtbar sind, und groß genug, dass die sie echten Impact haben.

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze zu einem Prozess, den du in Ordnung gebracht hast: wie er vorher aussah, was du verändert hast und was es dich gekostet hat, es durchzusetzen. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

ÜBER TIGER

VON TIGER FACILITY SERVICES ZU GOODWORKVIBES
Sagen wir es, wie es ist: Die verstaubte B2B-Reinigungsbranche ist seit Jahrzehnten geprägt von weichgespültem Corporate-Talk, billigen Ausreden und null Transparenz. Damit ist jetzt Schluss.

Was die Branche und unsere Kunden zu erwarten haben?

Wir ersetzen stumme Putzkolonnen durch direkte Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe, digitale Transparenz und ein Betreuungskonzept, das Kunden zu echten Fans macht. Bei uns bist du kein austauschbarer „Reklamationsabwickler“, sondern der strategische Partner für Office Manager und C-Level. WHAT YOU DO

Als Founders Associate bist du die zentrale Unterstützung unseres Founder's Offices in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Head of Operations und hilfst bei der Gestaltung und Umsetzung wichtiger Unternehmensinitiativen. Diese Rolle bietet eine einzigartige Chance, in einem dynamischen Umfeld umfassende Startup-Erfahrungen zu sammeln.

Deine Aufgaben umfassen:

  • Strategische Unterstützung: Zusammenarbeit mit dem Founders Office Team, insbesondere unserer Head of Operations, bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Unternehmensstrategien und Wachstumsinitiativen.

WHAT TO EXPECT

Ownership & Impact | Bei Code Gaia haben alle unsere Teammitglieder eine Stimme. Wir schätzen jede Meinung und ermutigen alle, ihre Meinung zu sagen. Nur mit Teamarbeit können wir etwas Sinnvolles schaffen. Wir glauben an unser Team und geben ihm daher viel Eigenverantwortung. Selbst wenn wir scheitern, lernen wir daraus, stehen wieder auf und arbeiten weiter am Erfolg. Das ist Teil des Spiels und wir wissen es.

Personal & Professional Growth | Deine Entwicklung ist unsere Priorität. Mit unserem intensiven Onboarding, Feedbackgesprächen und Schulungen fördern wir deine persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung. data.description:
XRbit is a research insitute developing innovative at the intersection of technology, science and digital learning.

Our interdisciplinary team combines software development, artificial intelligence, Extended Reality (XR), 3D technologies and interactive systems. We work together with universities, research institutions, educational organizations, museums and other partners to develop new ways of making complex topics accessible and tangible.

As our research and development activities increasingly combine software with physical systems, we are looking for someone who enjoys turning ideas into working hardware prototypes.

Aufgaben

You will develop and prototype hardware systems at the intersection of camera technology, embedded computing, sensor technology, mechanics and robotics.

A key part of your work will be the development of camera-based systems for computer vision and AI applications.

These systems may range from laboratory prototypes to robust systems intended for continuous operation in industrial or outdoor environments.

You will work closely with our software, AI and 3D development teams and help bridge the gap between software and the physical world.

Your tasks may include:

  • Designing, building and testing camera-based hardware systems
  • Integrating embedded computing platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi or comparable systems
  • Programming and connecting sensors, cameras, microcontrollers and other electronic components
  • Developing suitable concepts for thermal management, ventilation and condensation prevention
  • Producing prototype components using 3D printing and rapid prototyping
  • Documenting hardware architectures, components and technical decisions

Qualifikation

Your Profile

You should have a background in one or more of the following areas:

  • Mechatronics
  • Electrical Engineering
  • Embedded Systems
  • Automation Engineering
  • or a comparable technical field

Technical Skills

You should have practical experience with several of the following areas:

  • Programming C and/or C++ as well as Python
  • Embedded systems/ Microcontrollers
  • Linux-based systems
  • Cameras and image acquisition
  • 3D printing or other rapid-prototyping technologies

Most importantly, you should be comfortable combining software, electronics and mechanics into a working physical system.

Additional Experience That Would Be Valuable

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage, but is not required:

  • Machine Vision
  • Robotics/ Servo motors and stepper motors
  • PCB design
  • Electronics prototyping
  • Ruggedized electronics
  • Thermal management of embedded systems

Benefits

You will become part of an interdisciplinary environment where hardware development is closely connected to artificial intelligence, software development, 3D technologies and applied research.

We offer:

  • A technically diverse student position combining software and hardware development
  • Practical work on real-world prototypes rather than purely theoretical concepts
  • Direct involvement in research and development activities
  • Work with modern technologies in embedded systems, computer vision, AI and robotics
  • Access to prototyping and development infrastructure
  • Close collaboration with an interdisciplinary development team
  • A combination of on-site development work and remote work
  • Opportunities to develop your own technical ideas and contribute to prototype design

We are particularly interested in people who enjoy building things.

You should be comfortable moving from an initial idea to a first experimental setup, testing it, identifying problems and improving the system step by step.

For example, you might spend one day programming an embedded computer, another day testing a camera and lens combination, and the next day designing and 3D-printing a new enclosure or mounting system.

You do not need to be an expert in every technology listed above.

We value curiosity, technical creativity, structured problem-solving and the willingness to experiment with different approaches.

Personal or university projects involving robotics, electronics, embedded systems, drones, cameras, 3D printers, automation or similar technologies are very welcome and can be just as relevant as professional experience.

Interested?

Please send your application, CV and – if available – examples or short descriptions of technical projects you have worked on (GitHub repositories, project documentation, CAD models etc.)

Please only include information in your application that you consider relevant to your professional qualifications and experience.

XRbit welcomes applications from all qualified candidates. Selection is based on professional qualifications, relevant experience, skills and suitability for the position.

Your Mission

This is a company built for growth.

When you join exmox, you’re stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.

We build high-performing consumer products across multiple brands in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming. You will be part of a company on a path of hyper-growth, spearheading one of the largest innovations in the mobile gaming industry, rewarded user acquisition.

As a Senior Product Designer - UI Focus (f/m/x) at exmox, you'll join our product design team to shape the user interface and experience of our mobile-first B2C product, impacting millions of users. You'll own features from concept to handoff and create polished, engaging, habit-forming interfaces. This role is about designing experiences that perform. You’ll work at the intersection of user behavior, data, and business goals, shaping flows that drive engagement and revenue. Your work reaches over 25 million users and feeds directly into experimentation and iteration, letting you see the real impact of your decisions. At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.

Our product design team is growing in maturity, and you’ll play a key role in shaping how design works at exmox. If you want high impact, real ownership, and a product at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You’ll Own:

  • Feature ownership: Own and design new features from concept through final handoff.
  • UI design: Design visually engaging and highly polished interfaces for our B2C mobile app.
  • Visual assets: Create illustrations, icons, and other graphical assets to support your designs.
  • Developer handoff: Deliver production-ready assets, specifications, prototypes, and documentation to engineering teams.
  • Design system: Build, maintain, and contribute to our evolving design system.
  • Design quality: Conduct design reviews to ensure implementations match the intended designs.
  • Research collaboration: Work closely with UX research and data teams to evaluate and improve your designs.
  • Iteration & feedback: Gather feedback and continuously refine and improve your work.

What’s in it for you as a designer?

  • Impact: Your work directly influences a product used by millions. You’ll see the effect of your design decisions on business KPIs and learn how to create value through design.
  • Data-driven culture: Data sits at the core of every decision we make. You’ll design, test, and iterate based on real user insights and performance metrics.
  • Large global user base: You’ll design for a product with over 25 million users worldwide, operating at true scale.
  • Growing design maturity: Our product design team is on a journey to elevate design maturity at exmox, and you’ll actively shape and contribute to that evolution.
  • Cross-functional design team: You’ll collaborate within a dedicated design team including Product designers, UI Designers, and UX Researcher.

What You Bring

  • Portfolio: A portfolio showcasing outstanding mobile UI craft and visual design.
  • Professional experience: 5+ years of experience working in product teams as a UI, UI/UX, or Product Designer.
  • Consumer product design: Experience designing habit-forming, engaging, consumer-facing interfaces.
  • Industry background: Experience in marketing, gaming, or other B2C-heavy industries is a plus.

Hard Skills:

  • Design tools: Strong proficiency in Figma.
  • Motion & interaction design: Expertise in motion design, animation, and transitions to craft dynamic interfaces.
  • Visual asset creation: Expertise in creating illustrations, iconography, and other visual assets.
  • Design systems: Expertise in designing, shipping, and maintaining design systems.
  • Multi-brand products: Experience with multi-brand, white-label products and theming systems.
  • Brand identity: Experience in defining, designing, and documenting brand identities.
  • Copywriting: Experience in copywriting, including defining tone, voice, and messaging.
  • Accessibility & usability: Strong knowledge of accessibility and usability principles.
  • Frontend awareness: Understanding of front-end technologies and implementation constraints.
  • Language skills: Fluency in English; German is a plus.

Soft Skills:

  • Ownership: You take full responsibility for your work, drive initiatives forward, align stakeholders, and ensure meaningful value delivery.
  • Proactiveness: You anticipate challenges, identify opportunities, and take initiative without waiting for direction.
  • Prioritisation: You focus on what matters most, balance speed and quality, and manage your workload effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Feedback mindset: You give constructive feedback thoughtfully and embrace feedback as an essential part of iteration and growth, comfortably navigating multiple refinement cycles.
  • Creative thinking: You explore a wide range of ideas and solutions from safe bets to bold, out-of-the-box concepts to achieve the most impactful outcome.

How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

CCM-Systeme dienen als zentrale Plattform für alle Kundenkommunikationsprozesse und sind auf professionelle Einzel- und Massenkommunikation mit großen Dokumentenvolumina ausgerichtet. Das Tätigkeitsspektrum umfasst daher:

• Datenintegration aus vorgelagerten Systemen

• Erstellung, Gestaltung und Verwaltung von Content

• Bereitstellung für den richtigen Ausgabekanal

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten bei uns

  • Projektsteuerung: Du hast die Leitung bei der Planung, Steuerung und Umsetzung von Output Management Projekten inne oder unterstützt direkt die Gesamtprojektleiter*innen.
  • Konzeption und IT-Architektur: Du übernimmst die Entwicklung von CCM Architekturkonzepten und berätst im Rahmen der Lösungsauswahl und anschließender Realisierung.
  • Fachkonzeption: Dem jeweiligen Projektauftrag entsprechend übernimmst du die Erstellung und Prüfung von Fachkonzepten für Kommunikationsbausteine und Templates (Briefvorlagenmigration)
  • Strategische Beratung und Anforderungsmanagement: Du berätst zu Kommunikationsstrategien (z. B. Omnichannel, Individualisierung, Automatisierung) und organisierst und priorisierst fachlicher sowie technischer Anforderungen. Die Entwicklung von Zielbildern für zukunftsfähiges CCM ist zentraler Bestandteile deiner Tätigkeit.

Dein neuer Arbeitsalltag

  • Du übst deine Tätigkeit in einem dezentral organisierten Unternehmen aus, das heißt, dein Hauptarbeitsplatz ist zu 80-90% dein Home-Office am Wohnsitz
  • Entsprechend deiner Verantwortung im Projekt sowie dem Projektbedarf angemessen nimmst du eigenverantwortlich auch Vor-Ort-Tätigkeiten wahr.
  • Deinen Arbeitsalltag strukturierst du im Rahmen deiner Aufgaben selbstorganisiert und selbstbestimmt.

Das zeichnet Dich aus

Must-Have Kriterien:

  • Berufserfahrung in der Versicherungs- und Finanzbranche oder direkt bei Lösungsanbietern
  • Projekterfahrung im Rahmen von Großprojekten und Erfahrung in der Leitung von (Teil-)Projekten

  • Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Fach- und IT-Seite, auch auf Managementebene
  • Einen Blick fürs Ganze – auch über den Tellerrand des Projekts hinaus
  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich zu machen
  • Moderations- und Workshop-Kompetenz
  • Eine den Aufgabengebieten angemessene Methodenkompetenz (z. B. Requirement Engineering, Prozessmodellierung, agiles Projektvorgehen)
  • Grundsätzliche Reisebereitschaft in Deutschland und selten in der DACH-Region
  • Ausgezeichnete deutsche Sprachkenntnisse

Nice-to-Have Kriterien:

  • Kenntnisse angrenzender Themenbereiche (z. B. Enterprise Architecture, Change Management, KI/LLM)
  • Erfahrung mit regulatorischen Anforderungen (z. B. GDPR, BFSG, ISO 27001)
  • Verständnis für Schnittstellen- und Datenintegration (z. B. API-Know-how, XML, JSON, REST)
  • Experimentierfreude mit neuen Tools & Methoden
  • Technologische Neugier, die über das Projekt hinauswirkt

Du erhältst

  • Einen aufs Home Office zentrierten Arbeitsalltag
  • Attraktive Vergütung: Ein Fixum aus 14 Monatsgehältern kombiniert mit einem variablen Gehaltsbestandteil, das an unseren gemeinsamen Gesamterfolg der Pentadoc Gruppe gekoppelt ist.

Wir freuen uns über deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung (Gehaltsvorstellung, CV, Projektnachweise) und den anschießenden Austausch mit Dir!

Für alle, die sich bereits aufmerksam mit der Stellenbeschreibung befasst haben: Hier noch 4 weitere Gründe, jetzt bei PENTADOC durchzustarten

  • Flexibilität: Du hast erheblichen Einfluss auf deine Arbeitszeiten und Arbeitsorganisation und kannst so deine beruflichen Tätigkeiten und deine privaten Verpflichtungen besser aufeinander abstimmen
  • Moderne Arbeitskultur: Du wirst an den strategischen Entscheidungsprozessen beteiligt und kannst deine eigenen Ideen und Vorstellungen einbringen. Deine Meinung wird aktiv erfragt und dir wird anschließend zugehört.

As the Revenue Operations Manager for Retention & Expansion, you will own the strategic operationalization of SoSafe’s post-sales organization. This is a critical track within our 2026 RevOps and Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy. Your core mission is to maximize Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) and Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by building the frameworks, data, and intelligent automations that empower our Customer Success Managers (CSMs), Account Executives (AEs), and our brand-new team of dedicated Renewal Managers (RMs).

We have set an ambitious but achievable target: shifting towards 40%+ of our New ARR coming from expansion deals (Strategic Expansions, Renewal Upsells, and Amendment Upsells). You will be the architect behind the systems and processes that make this happen, as we move from pure New Logo creation focus to retention as our core business focus.

What you will own (key responsibilities)

  • Functional Lead for Retention & Expansion Operational Strategy: Serve as the functional lead for all things post-sales/customer success operations. Translate executive retention goals into crisp, repeatable operating rhythms, territory maps, and intelligent Book of Business (BoB) design.

  • Scale the Renewal Manager Lifecycle: Define, document, and oversee the end-to-end process for our newly formed Renewal Managers team. Standardize deal qualification, risk mitigation touchpoints, and digital contracting workflows in Salesforce and DocuSign. Take our renewals forecasting to the next level.

  • Drive AI-Native Automation: Partner with our dedicated GTM AI Engineering Team to infuse intelligent automation (via Clay, Zapier, Claude & Co.) into the daily routines of CSMs and Renewal Managers. Manage and lead initiatives like automated EBR (Executive Business Review) generation and programmatic renewal reminders to eliminate administrative overhead and make our CS organisation more productive.

  • Predictive Forecasting & Analytics: Take full ownership of renewal forecasting workflows inside and outside of Clari. Move our customer base metrics from "available data" to "actionable insights" by leading the rollout of Customer Healthscore V3, integrating product utilization analytics with Salesforce and Planhat insights.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as the strategic bridge between CS, Sales and Marketing leadership as well as our Product Organisation to build a friction-free customer journey. Align post-sales processes with our target mid-market enterprise ICP (501–5,000 employee companies in highly regulated sectors).

What You Bring (requirements)

  • Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in Revenue Operations, Customer Success Operations, or Growth Operations within a B2B SaaS environment ideally through a scale-up phase from €50M to €100M+ ARR.

  • Strategic Maturity: Proven experience directly leading an operational focus area. You don't just execute orders; you proactively identify funnel leakages, propose structural solutions to leadership, and drive change management.

  • Tech Stack Expertise: Advanced, hands-on experience with Salesforce (SFDC) and a leading revenue forecasting/analytics platform (ideally Clari or Gong/Planhat).

  • Automation & Next-Gen GTM: A strong familiarity with modern data enrichment and orchestrators (e.g., Clay, Zapier, or native AI-native tools). You believe that a highly efficient, automated RevOps team can outperform a traditional 20-person team.

  • SaaS Metrics & Analytical Rigor: Deep fluency in calculating and optimizing NRR, GRR, Expansion Velocity, and Churn cohorts. You know how to visually represent these metrics in dashboards that executive leadership can instantly look at to make decisions.

Why Join the SoSafe RevOps Team?

  • A Seat at the Table: Our RevOps organization manages the entire GTM stack and architecture. You will have direct exposure to executive leaders (CRO, COO, and Director of RevOps) and have a large, visible impact on our profitability journey.

  • Cutting-Edge Stack: We don’t tolerate legacy tech debt. You will work with a modern infrastructure, including Salesforce, HubSpot, Salesloft, Clari CoPilot, and cutting-edge tools like Clay or Claude.

  • Team Culture: Join a highly collaborative group of operations professionals and GTM engineers who balance top-tier technical performance with wit, humility, and zero ego. And join our fun team events!

What we offer*

  • Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days

  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, corporate discounts

  • Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups

  • And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, dog-friendly HQ

*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.

About Us

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects.

About Our Technology

The semiconductor industry's growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude. In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution.

The Role

At Black Semiconductor, logistics is more than moving materials from A to B. It is the infrastructure that keeps our operations running as we move towards production, it is becoming increasingly business-critical.

We are looking for a Senior Manager to take ownership of this function and help build it for our next stage of growth. This is a role for someone who enjoys both getting things done and building them up properly: you will participate in day-to-day operations, while at the same time developing the processes, structures and supply chain setup we need for the future.

Today, our logistics setup is very lean, giving you significant ownership from day one. With the setup and scaling of our main headquarters and new facility (FabONE), you will play a key role in scaling Black Semiconductor’s our operational capabilities as the company moves into production. You will work closely with our core business units to develop a reliable supply chain and strengthen compliance.

To Join Our Team, You Should Be Excited To:

  • Build and lead the logistics team and warehouse operations, providing both functional and disciplinary leadership.

  • To keep products moving, ensure reliable day-to-day logistics operations across domestic and international transportation, shipping and distribution, taking a hands-on approach where needed.

  • Develop and optimize end-to-end supply chain processes across warehousing, receiving, inventory, transportation, shipping and production support.

  • Drive initiatives to improve efficiency, quality, cost performance and delivery reliability, like our SAP S/4HANA rollout, establishing RASIC and best practices to building the team and capabilities needed for future growth.

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders across production, engineering, procurement and other business functions to ensure a reliable flow of materials and information.

  • Own dangerous goods handling and regulatory compliance, ensuring adherence to ADR, IATA, IMDG, and all relevant legal requirements

  • Ensure that compliance is an integral part of our logistics and supply chain processes right from the start.

Your Qualifications

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in logistics, supply chain or warehouse management, import/export or manufacturing operations

  • At least 4 years of disciplinary leadership and people management experience, ideally with responsibility for teams with 5+ employees

  • Experience in a startup/scale-up environment or complex corporate organization, ideally in semiconductor, pharmaceutical or another highly regulated industry

  • Deep expertise in supply chain management, material flow, inventory management, production support and import/export regulations

  • Strong hands-on experience with WMS and ERP systems (SAP/S/4HANA experience is a plus)

  • Proven expertise in dangerous goods, German regulatory requirements and compliance, ideally combined with cleanroom logistics experience

  • A pragmatic leadership mindset, strategic thinking, and strong problem-solving as well as stakeholder management skills.

  • Fluent German language skills (minimum: C1) and good English (minimum: B2)

What Makes This Role Different

Rather than maintaining existing playbooks, this is your chance to build a modern logistics function from the ground up. You will have the opportunity to shape the function from an early stage and define how logistics and supply chains should work at Black Semiconductor.

Your decisions will have a direct impact on our ability to operate, produce and scale. You will have the freedom to bring your expertise, challenge existing ways of working and build the team, processes and standards you believe are needed.

If you enjoy combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution, taking ownership and building something that will grow with the company, this is an opportunity to make a real difference.

Our Work Culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters.

Let's Grow Together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development.

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority — in the present and future.

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward.

We connect chips — and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry.

Can you picture yourself in this role and our company? Let's connect.

JOIN US

Bei Code Gaia zu arbeiten bedeutet, dass du an etwas sehr Wichtigem arbeitest: Der Transformation zu einer nachhaltigen Wirtschaft. Wir sind dafür da, dass Nachhaltigkeit nicht mühsam oder zeitaufwendig für Unternehmen ist. Stattdessen wollen wir kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen ermutigen, gemeinsam gegen den Klimawandel und soziale Ungerechtigkeit vorzugehen.

Als Internal Accountant bist du das Rückgrat unserer täglichen Finanzprozesse: Du verantwortest die laufende Buchhaltung, sorgst für saubere und pünktliche Zahlungsläufe und bist zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere externe Steuerberatung. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Finance Controller, unserem Revenue-Operations-Team und unserem Head of Finance zusammen und trägst so maßgeblich dazu bei, dass unser wachsendes Team auf einer soliden finanziellen Grundlage aufbauen kann.

WHAT YOU DO

  • Du verantwortest die laufende Finanzbuchhaltung (Kreditoren- und Debitorenbuchhaltung) und sorgst für eine saubere, revisionssichere Ablage aller Belege
  • Du prüfst Eingangsrechnungen, bereitest Zahlungsläufe vor und gibst sie über unser Tool Moss frei, damit bei uns finanziell nichts liegen bleibt
  • Du unterstützt bei Ausgangsrechnungen und offenen Forderungen über unsere Systeme (Younium, Easybill, HubSpot) und stimmst dich dazu mit Revenue Operations ab
  • Du übernimmst die Kreditkartenverwaltung und -abrechnung für das gesamte Team
  • Du bereitest den Monatsabschluss vor und arbeitest eng mit unserem Steuerberater zusammen
  • Du unterstützt bei der Pflege unseres Cash Calendars und lieferst dem Finance Controller verlässliche Zahlen für Liquiditätsplanung und Forecasts
  • Du erstellst Ad-hoc-Auswertungen und spezifische Reportings für den Head of Finance, Finance Controller und weitere Stakeholder
  • Wir unterstützen dich beim Einsatz von KI-Tools (z. B. Claude), mit denen du wiederkehrende Buchhaltungsprozesse automatisieren kannst.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Du bringst praktisch Erufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung oder Finance Operations mit, idealerweise im SaaS- oder Tech-Umfeld
  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung (z. B. Steuerfachangestellte:r, Bilanzbuchhalter:in) oder ein vergleichbares Studium mit Schwerpunkt Finance/Accounting
  • Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in der doppelten Buchführung sowie idealerweise erste Berührungspunkte mit SaaS-spezifischen Themen wie wiederkehrenden Umsätzen (ARR) oder Subscription Billing
  • Du arbeitest präzise, strukturiert und behältst auch bei hohem Belegvolumen und wiederkehrenden Aufgaben den Überblick
  • Du kommunizierst klar, freundlich und lösungsorientiert – auch im Kontakt mit externer Steuerberatung und Kund:innen
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit gängigen Buchhaltungs- und Rechnungsstellungs-Tools (z. B. Moss, DATEV, Younium, Easybill, HubSpot o. ä.)
  • Du bist zuverlässig, arbeitest gerne eigenverantwortlich und übernimmst Ownership für deinen Bereich
  • Du besitzt Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau
  • Du hast gute Englischkenntnisse, da unsere interne Arbeitssprache Englisch ist

WHAT TO EXPECT

Hybrid Work & Freedom | Wir glauben fest daran, dass jedes Arbeitsumfeld ideal und auf die jeweilige Person zugeschnitten sein muss. Aus diesem Grund arbeiten unsere Teammitglieder remote oder in unseren Büros in München oder Berlin - auf ihre eigene Art und Weise. So können wir sicherstellen, dass alle unsere Talente viel Freiraum haben, um die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

Ownership & Impact | Bei Code Gaia haben alle unsere Teammitglieder eine Stimme. Wir schätzen jede Meinung und ermutigen alle, ihre Meinung zu sagen. Nur mit Teamarbeit können wir etwas Sinnvolles schaffen. Wir glauben an unser Team und geben ihm daher viel Eigenverantwortung. Selbst wenn wir scheitern, lernen wir daraus, stehen wieder auf und arbeiten weiter am Erfolg. Das ist Teil des Spiels und wir wissen es.

Personal & Professional Growth | Deine Entwicklung ist unsere Priorität. Mit unserem intensiven Onboarding, Feedbackgesprächen und Schulungen fördern wir deine persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung. Einer unserer Kernwerte ist "Keep Growing" (Wachsen), den wir in allem, was wir tun, zum Ausdruck bringen.

Best Equipment, Tech Stack & Processes | Du arbeitest mit bewährten Prozessen, bist aber jederzeit eingeladen, diese zu hinterfragen. Außerdem möchten wir, dass du so produktiv wie möglich bist - sag uns, was du brauchen, um produktiv zu sein.

C ompetitive salary package | Wir bieten ein faires Gehalt. Code Gaia ist auf dem besten Weg, in die Höhe zu schießen, und wir möchten, dass du ein Teil davon bist und an unserer Wachstumsreise teilnimmst.

Team Events | Wir wissen, dass es schwierig sein kann, einen starken Teamgeist aufzubauen, wenn man ausschließlich aus der Ferne arbeitet. Bei Code Gaia legen wir jedoch großen Wert auf die Teambildung und veranstalten das ganze Jahr über verschiedene Teamevents. Schau dir z.B. den letzten LigaConvent unserer Unternehmensgruppe an. Wir verstehen die Notwendigkeit der Interaktion von Angesicht zu Angesicht und ermutigen sie stark.

Impact driven & passionate team | Zu guter Letzt sind wir das wirkungsorientierteste Team, das du dir vorstellen kannst. Wir lieben die Zusammenarbeit und leben unsere Unternehmenswerte jeden Tag. Darüberhinaus kompensiert Code Gaia natürlich den eigenen CO2-Fußabdruck.

Is it a Match?

Dann schicke uns gerne deine Unterlagen zu. Wir freuen uns, dich zeitnah kennenzulernen!

Bei Code Gaia wirst Du Teil eines multikulturellen und interdisziplinären Teams. Wir sind bestrebt, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem jeder Mitarbeitende seinen Beitrag bestmöglich einbringen kann. Daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Hintergründe, Identitäten und Erfahrungshorizonte.

Company & Role Overview 

About Hilo by Aktiia 

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. 

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. 

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. 

Role overview

As Post-Market Surveillance Manager, you'll build and run our global post-market surveillance system — from complaint handling and adverse-event reporting to data trending and governance — and lead its rollout across Customer Support, QA, Regulatory, Engineering, Clinical, and Product. This is a hands-on role: you'll turn post-market insights into action that improves product quality, patient safety, and the customer experience, drawing on strong judgment, disciplined execution, and the ability to influence stakeholders globally. 

Requirements

Core responsibilities

  • Design, build, and run our global post-market surveillance system — complaint handling, adverse-event/vigilance reporting, escalation, and governance — staying hands-on for complex or high-risk cases
  • Own the complaint-to-report pipeline: reportability assessments and timely, accurate adverse-event/vigilance submissions across markets (US, EU, and others)
  • Build the KPIs, dashboards, and trending methods that surface safety, quality, and customer-experience signals — and turn findings into action via CAPA, risk management, product/software fixes, and labeling updates
  • Lead the cross-functional rollout — implementation plans, priorities, dependencies, and risk — to build sustainable post-market processes and infrastructure
  • Present post-market performance and recommendations to leadership, and support PMS reports, PSURs, and management reviews 
  • Act as SME during audits and inspections, and guide internal teams and external partners on post-market activities 

Background & Experience

  • 7+ years in medical-device post-market surveillance, complaint handling, quality, or regulatory affairs, including leading process implementations 
  • At least a bachelor's degree
  • Hands-on experience with complaint investigations, reportability assessments, and regulatory submissions (FDA MDR, EU MDR vigilance/PMS, ISO 13485, ISO 14971), plus post-market data analysis
  • Program management skills — workstreams, stakeholders, dependencies — plus an analytical mindset for turning complaint data into risk-based recommendations 
  • Strong communicator, comfortable influencing cross-functional teams, leadership, and regulators
  • Hands-on, independent leadership style; able to scale processes as we grow
  • Nice to have: experience with additional international markets or digital complaint-management systems

What success looks like

  • Scalable processes for complaint intake, investigation, and resolution — with clear escalation pathways to ensure adverse events and reportable incidents are identified, assessed, and reported within regulatory timeline
  • Customer Support consistently identifies, documents, and escalates complaints and potential safety events, thanks to close partnership and training
  • KPIs and dashboards give clear visibility into complaint timeliness, resolution, regulatory reporting, and emerging trends
  • Post-market insights translate into action — product improvements, CAPAs, risk-management updates, and a better customer experience

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: 

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You let data and clarity guide your decisions, and you take accountability for results. You're a difference maker — you drive ideas to commercial success from start to end 

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with quality. You treat feedback as a chance to learn, and you're deep in customer and partner feedback — translating it to action quickly

Team First — You collaborate effectively across teams and build trust through clarity and respect. You're comfortable bridging local execution with a global team, and you communicate openly across time zones

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team
  • Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location)

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

About Us

STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionizing the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop and manufacture high performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost effective. This provides our operators with a decisive edge in highly contested environments.
We’re focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems—not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe—today.


About the team

Minerva is STARK's command and control software — the brain that connects operators to autonomous systems across multiple domains in real time. The Minerva team is a small, senior software group based in Berlin and Munich, working directly with our systems and hardware teams to build mission-critical C2 capabilities deployed in active operational environments.
We move fast, ship real software, and operate under constraints most engineers never encounter — low-bandwidth networks, air-gapped devices, high-stakes decision loops. There is no room for abstraction for its own sake. Everything we build ends up in the hands of real operators in the field.


Your mission

Support the development, integration, testing, and operational use of tactical data link capabilities for STARK’s unmanned systems, Ground Control Stations, and wider command-and-control environments. You will help ensure that our systems can communicate reliably and securely with military networks, command posts, allied platforms, and mission systems. A key part of the role is to evaluate, understand, and integrate tactical communication standards and technologies such as Link 16, Link 22, SATCOM, and other military data link solutions. You will translate operational communication requirements into practical integration concepts, test setups, and deployable system configurations.


Responsibilities

Tactical Data Link Integration: Support the integration of tactical data link capabilities such as Link 16, Link 22, SATCOM, and other military communication systems into STARK platforms and Ground Control Station environments.

Interoperability Concepts: Define and support communication concepts that enable reliable data exchange between unmanned systems, GCS setups, command centers, allied platforms, and external mission systems.

Requirements Translation: Translate operational and military communication requirements into technical integration requirements, interface definitions, test needs, and subsystem-level implementation concepts.

System Interface Support: Work with engineering, software, network, RF, modem, antenna, and GCS teams to align interfaces, protocols, data flows, configuration requirements, and integration constraints.

SATCOM & Beyond-Line-of-Sight Support: Support concepts and integration activities for SATCOM, long-range communication paths, and other beyond-line-of-sight connectivity options.

Testing & Validation: Plan and support lab tests, field tests, interoperability checks, and validation activities for tactical data link and communication setups.

Security & Reliability: Contribute to secure, robust, and mission-ready communication architectures, considering availability, latency, data integrity, authentication, and operational constraints.

Supplier & Partner Coordination: Work with external suppliers, partners, military stakeholders, and internal teams to assess data link options, integration dependencies, and technical feasibility.

Documentation: Document data link concepts, interface assumptions, configuration settings, integration dependencies, test results, and recommended operational setups in a clear and maintainable way.


Qualifications

Experience: Around 5 years of professional experience in tactical communications, military data links, SATCOM, RF systems, communication engineering, systems engineering, or a related technical field.

Tactical Data Link Knowledge: Practical understanding of military data link technologies such as Link 16, Link 22, SATCOM, or comparable tactical communication systems.

Systems Understanding: Ability to understand complex communication architectures involving platforms, radios, antennas, modems, networks, command systems, software interfaces, and operational workflows.

Interoperability Mindset: Strong understanding of how different systems exchange data, how interfaces are defined, and how interoperability is tested and validated.

Technical Communication: Ability to translate between operational users, engineering teams, software developers, RF specialists, suppliers, and program stakeholders.

Testing & Documentation: Experience supporting technical tests, integration trials, validation activities, or operational demonstrations, including structured documentation of results and findings.

Problem-Solving Ability: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify communication issues, integration gaps, configuration problems, and practical solutions.

Communication: Solid English skills are required. German skills for technical communication, stakeholder alignment, and documentation are a plus.

Team Fit: Ability to work collaboratively in a small, cross-functional team and communicate clearly and reliably in fast-moving engineering environments.

Clearance: Ability to obtain appropriate security clearance required for the position.


Nice to have

 Experience in defence, military communications, command-and-control systems, aerospace, naval systems, UAVs, or other mission-critical operational environments.

· Prior exposure to NATO communication standards, tactical networks, joint fires, air defence, command posts, or battlefield management systems.

· Experience with SATCOM terminals, tactical radios, MANET, IP-based tactical networks, or professional communication equipment.

· Experience integrating unmanned systems into wider military communication architectures.

· Understanding of network security, encryption concepts, authentication, routing, IP networking, and secure data exchange.

Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

Where the team comes in:

We're now applying that same model to Enterprise: the part of the market where businesses, not private individuals, sell vehicles to dealers. It's 2 million of the 8 million used cars sold in the UK each year, a quarter of the total market.

In May 2026 we launched our Enterprise remarketing service with Mobilize Financial Services (the finance arm behind Renault, Nissan, Dacia and Alpine) as our first customer (see launch article here). Mobilize’s end-of-lease customers profile their car through Motorway’s market-leading app, we auction the vehicle directly to dealers, and the vehicle is collected from the customer at the end of the lease. This cuts weeks out of a process that used to require physical storage sites and repeat transport, saving costs and time; and delivering a better customer experience.

This role joins the Enterprise team that is building this business line from the ground up. It's a rare chance to shape a new, fast-growing product inside an already fast-growing scale-up, and help rebuild a part of the automotive industry that our CEO has called "well overdue a rebuild." If you’re excited about building a ground-breaking business that redefines an industry, this role is for you.

About the team:

The Enterprise Operations Team sits at the centre of this new, high-growth business line. You'll be the main point of contact for our enterprise lease customers, guiding them through every step of the return and inspection process, and you'll work directly with purchasing dealer partners to keep the buying process smooth on their side too.

Every interaction you handle shapes how supported, informed and confident our lease customers and dealers feel. The structured approach and attention to detail you bring drives operational excellence and keeps customer satisfaction high as we grow in the lease vehicle market.

You'll be joining an ambitious new chapter for Motorway from day one.

What you'll be doing:

This is a generalist role where you will be working with customers and dealers managing the end-to-end sales process from the initial vehicle appraisal through to final inspection and collection:

  • Enterprise Customer Contact: Be the primary point of contact for enterprise lease customers via phone (inbound and outbound) email and WhatsApp, guiding them through their vehicle return and inspection process.

  • Research and development into new projects and technologies;

  • Maintenance of the kit and equipment needed to run the system.

Why Is This the Right Job for You?

This position is perfect for you if you possess:

  • A technical grounding

  • Strong problem-solving skills

  • Great teamwork skills

  • A passion for innovation

  • A willingness to learn

About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  3. Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

Reporting to the Recoveries and Litigation Manager, the Recoveries Agent will be responsible for completing a wide range of administrative activities within strict timescales to meet the needs of our customers, our third party suppliers including debt collection agencies, recovery agents and vehicle auction houses, as well as internally within the wider business.

The Recoveries Team plays a crucial role in asset management by ensuring the timely retrieval of our vehicles. This involves close coordination and communication with external recovery agents and auction houses to schedule and facilitate the collection process. The team is also responsible for managing the complexities involved in recovering impounded or seized vehicles, which may require interaction with legal authorities and adherence to specific procedures. Additionally, the Recoveries Team handles incoming communications from recovery agents and auction houses, responding to inquiries, providing necessary information, and addressing any issues that may arise during the recovery process.

What you’ll be doing

  • Effectively respond to inbound customer and third party supplier communications through multiple channels including debt collection agencies, recovery agents and auction houses.

  • Initiate outbound communications (calls and emails) to recovery agents and other third party suppliers when necessary.

  • Evaluate customers’ financial circumstances to determine their ability to repay their arrears and recommend appropriate solutions.

  • Follow company policies and legal regulations regarding financial support practices, including documenting all communication with customers and update account information accurately in the company's systems.

  • Review potential accounts for placement with third party suppliers and instruct appropriate suppliers accordingly.

  • Issue Statutory Notices to customers including Notices of Default and Termination, as well as regulatory notices on post-terminated accounts.

  • Deal with accounts where the vehicle has been seized and impounded.

  • Complete administrative tasks as required for the efficient operation of internal processes and external supplier processes. This may also include training material preparation and any other administrative requirement identified by management.

  • Ensure that our customers are treated fairly at all times in line with Consumer Duty.

  • Support the wider team and take the lead in the Recoveries and Litigation Managers absence.

  • Stay up to date on industry trends, regulations and best practices in financial support and recoveries.

What we’re looking for

  • Previous recoveries experience in motor finance is preferred but not essential.

  • Experience taking ownership for managing processes and speaking to external parties.

  • Good understanding of procedures, systems and processes within the department.

  • Logical and common sense approach to evaluate situations and select appropriate solutions based on experience and an understanding of procedures.

  • Strong prioritisation skills, ability to organise and work independently.

  • Resilient and calm approach when faced with difficult situations.

  • Takes responsibility and demonstrates accountability to ensure high-quality output.

  • Able to adapt written and verbal communication to an individual's needs.

Who you are:

  • Be a team player, flexible and able to work on your own initiative.

  • Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to establish effective working relationships at all levels.

  • Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail for maintaining accurate records and documentation.

  • Demonstrates a sense of urgency and good work ethic.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Rapport building with colleagues, customers and suppliers.

  • Ability to work to deadlines.

  • Problem solving skills.

  • Ability to operate comfortably in a fast paced and changing environment.

Interview process

  • 30 minute call with a member of the Talent team

  • A Take Home Task

  • Interviews with the Recoveries & Litigation Manager as well as other key stakeholders

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Orbital Industries is an AI Industrial company, with frontier AI embedded at every step in the production of critical physical products - from creating advanced materials to engineering and manufacturing.

Every Orbital Industries product is developed using CurieOS, our AI operating system, uniting AI-automated hardware engineering with AI-designed material science to achieve breakthrough real-world performance. We also offer CurieOS to our customers and partners, extending the same platform and workflows that power Orbital Industries to their own teams and products.

We have an ambitious mission and need excellent people in all our teams - AI research, operations, advanced materials, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering and manufacturing.

Working at Orbital Industries means working in vertically integrated teams across the full stack, from molecules to manufacturing. We're looking for people who have a love of physical technology, curiosity in AI and a desire to learn.

Role Overview

We're hiring a Communications Lead to define how Orbital Industries is understood in the market - and to build the communications motion that makes that understanding stick.

This is a category-creation brief. You'll articulate what the AI Industrial is, why CurieOS matters, and how Orbital Industries' full-lifecycle approach (materials, engineering, hardware) represents something genuinely new. You'll translate deep technical work - across AI, materials science, and hardware engineering - into clear, distinctive, high-quality communication that builds authority with investors, technical buyers, talent, and the broader market.

Your job is to set the strategic direction: brand voice, messaging frameworks, content strategy, and open doors for media.

Key Responsibilities

Communications Strategy and Brand Voice

  • Define and own Orbital Industries' external communications strategy — how we are positioned, perceived, and understood in the market

  • Build and enforce consistency in brand voice across all external channels: website, social, events, collateral, press

  • Set the messaging framework for CurieOS and its three pillars (Materials, Deployment, Hardware), ensuring our full-lifecycle positioning is sharp and differentiated

  • Write strong creative and messaging briefs for design, video, and campaign work — giving the GTM team clear strategic direction to execute against

  • Ensure a clean separation between Orbital Industries (brand authority, category definition) and Orbital IT (commercial, customer-facing) in how we communicate externally

Stakeholder messaging

  • Work closely with the CFO and founders to ensure investor messaging reflects Orbital Industries' positioning as the AI Industrial category leader, not just a product company

  • Translate technical milestones (CurieOS releases, customer deployments, materials breakthroughs) into compelling narratives

Content and copy

  • Own long-form writing, thought leadership, website messaging, investor content, and campaign assets - from strategy through to production

  • Produce content that makes Orbital Industries' work in AI, materials science and hardware engineering accessible without losing credibility or nuance — you know the difference between simplifying and dumbing down

  • Develop and maintain CurieOS content across its three pillars: materials discovery, deployment engineering, and hardware product development

  • Use LLMs and modern tools to work efficiently while maintaining high editorial standards

Social Media Strategy

  • Own organic social strategy: voice, editorial calendar, content direction and output quality

  • Build Orbital Industries' social presence into a distinctive point of view, not just a broadcast channel — the GTM team handles day-to-day posting and scheduling

  • Track developments across AI infrastructure and adjacent industries to keep content timely and credible

  • Partner with the GTM Lead to align organic and paid social messaging

Website messaging

  • Own website copy and landing-page messaging, ensuring it is sharp, current and aligned to business priorities

  • Work closely with the GTM team on copy for campaign landing pages — you own the message, they own the conversion optimisation and testing cycle

Press and Media

  • Develop Orbital Industries' press function - strengthening media relationships, identifying opportunities, and positioning the company for coverage that reinforces our authority in the AI Industrial category

  • Amplify founder positioning for external audiences, interviews, speaking engagements and media appearances

  • Manage freelance press support and scale the function as the company grows

What We're Looking For

  • Significant leadership experience in communications, content, editorial or brand storytelling — ideally in a technical, deep-tech or science-adjacent environment. Experience with investor communications or fundraising narratives is a strong plus

  • An excellent writer with strong editorial taste and clear judgement; your portfolio should demonstrate range across long-form, short-form and messaging work

  • Deep curiosity about AI, science, engineering or technical products — you follow these spaces because you're genuinely interested, not because it's your job

  • The ability to make technical ideas accessible without losing credibility or nuance

  • Comfortable owning both strategy and execution — you can set the direction, produce the work, and build the systems that maintain quality without you touching every piece

  • Experience building or significantly expanding a communications function — you should find creating something from scratch exciting, not uncomfortable

  • High standards for writing, messaging, and brand consistency — you notice when things drift and you fix them before they compound

  • Strong collaborative instincts — you'll work closely with technical founders, engineers, a GTM Lead, a design function. You need to influence without owning every channel

  • Experience briefing and managing creative work: design, video, freelance writers, press agencies

  • Science degree or background is preferred

Why Join Orbital Industries?

  • Competitive salary and equity package - the ability to own part of Orbital Industries as we grow

  • Flexible and generous paid time off

  • Excellent health, dental and vision insurance plan

  • Regular company offsites to the USA and beyond

  • The chance to define the narrative for a new category — the AI Industrial — at a company where communications is a strategic function, not a support one

Orbital is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

About OLIX

AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance.

The Role

We're hiring a IT Systems Engineer to own the reliability and evolution of the tools every team at OLIX depends on day to day: identity and SSO, device management across Mac and Windows, Google Workspace, and the wider collaboration and business-systems stack including Slack, Notion and Atlassian. As headcount grows, so does the load on these systems, and we need someone to own their architecture and roadmap rather than just keep them running.

You'll be the final escalation point for complex, cross-system problems, and you'll lead company-wide systems projects from scoping through delivery. A significant identity provider and device management migration is on the near-term roadmap, so there's substantial architectural work from day one.

Beyond the core stack, you'll act as OLIX's AI enabler: finding the manual tools and processes worth removing, evaluating tools, and building agents and automations that act as a force multiplier across the business, all while holding a high bar on security and IP protection. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role with the freedom to define how IT and internal systems work here from the ground up.

Responsibilities

  • Strengthen the core stack: own the architecture and roadmap for our business-systems stack, including IDP/IAM, Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Atlassian and adjacent HRIS, ATS and finance platforms, and make sure they scale ahead of OLIX's growth.

  • Lead IT and systems projects end to end: take medium-to-large, company-wide projects from scoping through delivery, automating recurring work, streamlining tooling, and improving the day-one and day-to-day experience for every OLIX employee.

  • Be the escalation point: act as the final escalation point for complex, cross-system issues, providing expert-level root cause analysis and implementing architectural changes that stop problems recurring.

  • Build agents and automations: champion AI adoption across the business, partnering with functional teams to design scalable, automated processes and building the tools, scripts and workflows (Google Workspace and Apps Script, IDP APIs) that eliminate manual toil.

  • Own secure onboarding of new tools: partner with InfoSec on SaaS vendor reviews and rollout, so new tools arrive with SSO, SCIM and least-privilege access in place.

  • Raise the bar as you go: find and fix friction or quality gaps in how IT and systems operate without being asked, mentor others, and be a visible example of ownership in the team.

Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years in IT systems engineering, with a track record of owning systems end to end rather than working tickets within someone else's design.

  • Expert-level knowledge of Windows and Mac device management, Google Workspace administration, and Google Cloud Identity across users, devices and applications.

  • Deep, hands-on experience with SSO and identity platforms, ideally Okta, OneLogin, JumpCloud. Experience rebuilding or migrating between identity providers is a strong plus given our roadmap.

  • Experience administering SaaS and collaboration tools at company scale, Slack, Notion and Atlassian (Jira/Confluence) in particular.

  • An AI-first mindset: a practical focus on using AI and LLM-powered tools to streamline IT operations, improve user self-service and automate repetitive work, and a habit of building agents that act as force multipliers for the business.

  • Coding and scripting experience in one or more general-purpose languages, plus familiarity with Google Workspace developer tools (Apps Script, Workspace APIs).

  • Solid grasp of IT security fundamentals: role-based access control, least-privilege access, MDM, data security and identity best practice.

  • Proven ownership: a track record of taking ambiguous, medium-to-large problems and driving them to durable resolution without heavy oversight.

Nice to have: exposure to a fast-moving hardware or deep-tech startup, and comfort with infrastructure-as-code-style change management culture.

Compensation & Equity

  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with your experience, skills, and location

  • Equity & Ownership: Meaningful stock options. You're not just joining the mission; you're owning a piece of it

  • Proximity Bonus: We value your time. To minimise your commute and maximise your life, we offer an annual Living-Local Bonus if your residence is within 20 minutes of the office

  • Retirement Benefits: Employer-contributed retirement plans to help you build long-term financial security.

Due to U.S. export control regulations, candidates' eligibility to work at OLIX depends on their most recent citizenship or permanent residency status. We are generally unable to consider applicants whose most recent citizenship or permanent residence is in certain restricted countries (currently including Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Russia, Belarus, China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Venezuela). Applicants who have subsequently obtained citizenship or permanent residency in another country not subject to these restrictions may still be eligible.
